title: Exchange on a pointed representative
statement: theorem exchange_pointed_representative (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)} {f : X ⟶ Y} {s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y} (sq : CommSq g' f' f s) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)) (V : Y.Etale) (v : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj V) : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber V v ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F).obj ≫ (geometricPointSourceStalkIso Λ s ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f).obj F)).inv ≫ (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))).sheafFiber.map ((baseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq).app F) = geometricFibreSectionRestriction Λ sq F V v ≫ (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections _ _ (IsTerminal.isTerminalOfObj (MorphismProperty.Over.forget @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ X') (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X')) Over.mkIdTerminal)).inv.app ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').obj F) ≫ (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f').inv.app ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').obj F) ≫ (Sheaf.ΓNatIsoSheafSections _ _ (IsTerminal.isTerminalOfObj (MorphismProperty.Over.forget @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ (Spec (.of Ω))) (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))) Over.mkIdTerminal)).hom.app ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f').obj ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').obj F)) ≫ (Scheme.pointSmallEtale (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))).toPresheafFiber (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))) (Over.homMk (𝟙 _) (Category.comp_id _)) ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f').obj ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g').obj F)).obj

proof.text: Use the existing private sourceStalkIso_germ theorem from GeometricFibreExchangeGerms via a proof-only import all, rather than reproving the inverse-image stalk comparison. Germ naturality and unit_map_baseChangeMap_app rewrite exchange on the representative as the g′ unit followed by the pushforward square comparison. Restrict the pointed neighbourhood over Spec Omega along its marked section to the terminal germ. Identify the resulting iterated pullback lift by its projections with geometricFibreSectionLift. Expanding lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso and transporting terminal evaluations via Sheaf.GammaRes_map gives precisely the three target comparison factors. This is the representative calculation already contained in the proved geometricFibreExchange_germs, used here for a commutative square with no cartesianness assumption. The terminal evaluation transport uses the existing private eval_eq_res theorem from UnderivedGlobalGermExchange via a proof-only import all; no duplicate helper is declared.

mathlib_searches.query: A canonical isomorphism of modules between the stalk of an etale direct image and global sections on the strict henselization base change, with germ formula; exchange compatibility with fibre restriction
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits per query, on structure-sheaf stalk maps in Spec/AffineScheme, Scheme.stalkMap_germ, and ModuleCat.Tilde.germ_comp_stalkToFiberLinearMap. These concern Zariski structure-sheaf or tilde stalks, not the etale direct image or exchange.

12 hits including presheafFiber_hom_ext, toPresheafFiber_naturality, toPresheafFiber_w, and toPresheafFiber_presheafFiberDesc. These are general colimit tools, not the desired etale comparison or exchange identity.

mathlib_searches.results: No Mathlib sites hits and no exact library theorem. The library has the set-valued continuity theorem and the module/set inverse-image comparison; the finite base-change stalk-restriction theorem only computes pointwise restrictions, not the global-section factorization.
